newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX hits year-high on blue chip gains.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX hits year-high on blue chip gains.

text.p: Slovak blue chips closed mostly higher in flat trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Monday, pushing the SAX index up 0.24 points to a year high of 196.91.
Drug producer Slovakofarma, which closed up 100 at 4,800 crowns, led the bourse higher, but brokers said only a few issues were currently showing signs of life on the bourse.
"One can say several blue chips are performing very well, and they manage to draw attention for the whole market," Radovan Dzugas of Creditanstalt said.
Steel maker VSZ closed unchanged at 695 crowns, with dealers saying both it and Slovakofarma had the potential to rise further.
Overall volume rose to 377,456 shares, from 276,291 shares traded on Friday, while turnover eased to 228.65 million crowns, from 352.38 million.
